name: 適用範囲を説明する言語と利用場所の設定
prompt:
Input roles: Image 1: authoritative Japanese mock: exact layout, text scale and spacing. Image 2: original crop: card and chevron anatomy only. Image 3: approved restrained color direction.
Use case: precise UI reconstruction. Recreate the Japanese mock exactly as shown at 390x284. It is the sole layout, content, spacing and scale authority. This is a faithful reproduction, not a redesign, and should not inherit the generated layouts from earlier attempts. Keep two headings and two cards. Exact landmarks: first heading x16,y20; first card x16,y62,w358,h70; second heading x16,y173; second card x16,y214,w358,h70, bottom edge flush with y284. Preserve 16px outer margins and compact spacing. Each card has a bold value, a smaller muted single-line helper, and one small right chevron. Exact strings: 言語; 英語（米国）; このアプリで使用する主な言語です。; 国・地域; 米国; このアプリを利用する国・地域です。 The source crop is only for the shape and internal alignment of the setting cards and chevrons. Use white background, very light neutral row surfaces, dark slate text and muted gray supporting text/icons. Keep the exact text scale shown in the Japanese mock. No additional spacing, shadows, action gradient, phone frame or copy. Output the panel only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
